text:
sam: Heads-up I opened a tiny docs PR to update the console dashboard examples and tracehook snippets. Playground panels are blank because metrics changed names.

anya: link? ran into this in the preview too.

sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5230 
summary: replace legacy `latency_ms` with `p50_latency_ms`, include `p95_latency_ms` as an extra_series, rename tracehook param `trace_id_header` -> `trace_key_header` across samples, add compat note.

mike: can you paste the before/after for the yaml and the py snippet? quick review.

sam: old yaml:
```yaml
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
```
new yaml:
```yaml
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service=\"console\"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
```
python tracehook old->new:
```python
# old
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_id_header='x-rw-trace')
# new
TraceHook(header='x-rw-trace', trace_key_header='x-rw-trace-key')
# note: trace_id_header shim kept for backward compat but deprecated
```

anya: UX: include one-liner under the chart: "Use p50 for centroid latency; surface p95 for tail. Keep p95 collapsed by default." Also add troubleshooting: blank panels = wrong metric name.

mike: added a tiny nit in the PR about escaping backticks in a fenced example. Otherwise :+1:

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck flagged /console/observability/old-latency-guide -> 404; lint warns about deprecated `latency_ms` in examples/dashboard_examples.yaml

sam: added redirect note for jonah (infra) to create a redirect after merge. Also swapped an external blog link that returned 410 with the internal perf primer.

anya: LGTM, approved.

docs-bot: PR merged by sam (docs CI: success) 026-04-09T01:30:00Z site deploy scheduled.

sam: thanks all, closing thread.
